svg.title: Mean daily CH₄ and N₂O flux per cell of soil temperature and soil water content, one panel per site and gas.
svg.desc: Five heat maps: x axis daily mean soil temperature (°C, −2 to 22), y axis daily mean soil water content (m³ m⁻³, 0.08 to 0.80), the same axes in all panels. Top row CH₄ at Anttila and Särkisuo (µmol m⁻² s⁻¹); bottom row N₂O at Anttila, Särkisuo and Viikki (nmol m⁻² s⁻¹). Cells of 2 °C by 0.04 m³ m⁻³ with 5 or more days; colour = mean daily flux, diverging around 0, each panel with its own colour scale. Anttila CH₄: 40 cells, 663 of 724 days; largest mean 0.00309 µmol CH₄ m⁻² s⁻¹ at 6 to 8 °C and 0.28 to 0.32 m³ m⁻³ (n = 5). Särkisuo CH₄: 29 cells, 375 of 504 days; largest mean 0.0836 µmol CH₄ m⁻² s⁻¹ at 12 to 14 °C and 0.76 to 0.80 m³ m⁻³ (n = 16). Anttila N₂O: 40 cells, 663 of 724 days; largest mean 0.884 nmol N₂O m⁻² s⁻¹ at 16 to 18 °C and 0.28 to 0.32 m³ m⁻³ (n = 18). Särkisuo N₂O: 29 cells, 375 of 504 days; largest mean 6.08 nmol N₂O m⁻² s⁻¹ at 12 to 14 °C and 0.36 to 0.40 m³ m⁻³ (n = 8). Viikki N₂O: 70 cells, 1216 of 1294 days; largest mean 5.44 nmol N₂O m⁻² s⁻¹ at 14 to 16 °C and 0.36 to 0.40 m³ m⁻³ (n = 10). Soil water ranges (m³ m⁻³): Anttila 0.11 to 0.45; Särkisuo 0.29 to 0.80; Viikki 0.10 to 0.53. Grey = no cell. The flux values are gap-filled. Flux > 0 = emission.
